notes:
### Product Research Notes: ClickUp

#### 1. What the Product Does
ClickUp is an all-in-one productivity and project management platform designed to centralize tasks, documents, goals, chat, and time tracking into a single workspace.
* **Source URL:** `https://www.eesel.ai/blog/clickup-pricing-2026` (via Google Search)
* **Verbatim Quote:** *"ClickUp sells itself as the one app to replace all your other work apps. It's a big promise, and the idea of having tasks, docs, chat, and goals all in one place sounds pretty great."*

#### 2. Public API Authentication Methods
ClickUp supports two primary authentication methods:
* **Personal API Tokens (`bearer_token`):** Used primarily for personal scripts or single-user testing.
* **OAuth 2.0 (`oauth2`):** Required for multi-tenant integrations where external users authorize access to their workspaces.
* **Primary Auth for Multi-Tenant Integration:** `oauth2`
* **Source URL:** `https://developer.clickup.com/docs/Getting%20Started`
* **Verbatim Quote:** *"For personal use, authenticate with your personal api token . for apps or integrations that other people use, use the oauth flow , allowing users to authorize workspaces for your app."*
* **Source URL:** `https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6303422883095-Create-your-own-app-with-the-ClickUp-API`
* **Verbatim Quote:** *"when you want to develop an application that others can use, you must use an oauth2 authentication flow. with oauth 2, everyone who uses your app gets assigned an individualized token."*

#### 3. Developer Credentials Acquisition & Cost
* **Access Classification:** `self_serve_free`
* **Cost:** The API is completely free to use and is included across all subscription tiers, including the Free Forever plan.
* **Credential Acquisition:** Workspace owners or administrators can instantly create an OAuth application directly from their workspace settings to generate a Client ID and Client Secret. No manual review, partner program, or sales contact is required.
* **Source URL:** `https://help.clickup.com/hc/en-us/articles/6303422883095-Create-your-own-app-with-the-ClickUp-API`
* **Verbatim Quote:** *"the clickup api is available on all clickup plans . workspace owners or admins can manage integration settings and create oauth apps in the workspace."* and *"on the next screen, you'll see that a client id and client secret have been generated. use the client id and client secret in your app to create an oauth 2 authentication flow."*
* **Source URL:** `https://www.scalekit.com/blog/clickup-mcp-server-vs-rest-api` (via Google Search)
* **Verbatim Quote:** *"It is available on every ClickUp plan, including Free Forever."*

#### 4. API Style & Technical Details
* **API Style:** REST API (currently transitioning from v2 to v3).
* **Breadth:** Extremely broad, covering tasks, checklists, comments, chat, views, webhooks, custom task types, time tracking, user groups, folders, spaces, and workspaces.
* **OpenAPI Spec:** Provided officially by ClickUp.
* **Webhooks:** Fully supported with endpoints to create, update, and delete webhooks.
* **Sandbox:** No dedicated sandbox environment is provided, but developers can use the Free Forever plan to create a testing workspace.
* **Source URL:** `https://developer.clickup.com/docs/Getting%20Started`
* **Verbatim Quote:** *"build your own custom integrations and clickup apps with our public application programming interface (api)."* and *"in the api reference section you will find a few individual endpoints that are defined as api v3. we're working on updating the rest of the api to v3 and provide a dedicated guide for api v3."* and *"openapi specification"*
* **Source URL:** `https://developer.clickup.com/`
* **Verbatim Quote:** *"api browse our public api specification."* and *"webhooks trigger workflows from clickup events."*
* **Source URL:** `https://developer.clickup.com/reference/getaccesstoken`
* **Verbatim Quote:** *"get webhooks get create webhook post update webhook put delete webhook del"*

#### 5. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers
* **MCP Classification:** `official`
* **Details:** ClickUp hosts an official MCP server (currently in public beta) at `https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp`. It allows AI agents to interact directly with workspace data using natural language via OAuth authentication.
* **Source URL:** `https://developer.clickup.com/`
* **Verbatim Quote:** *"connect your ai with clickup using our mcp server."*
* **Source URL:** `https://clickup.com/mcp` (via Google Search)
* **Verbatim Quote:** *"Our MCP server URL is https://mcp.clickup.com/mcp . What you can do. With ClickUp's MCP server, you can: Orchestrate task workflows: Manage tasks with assignees..."*

#### 6. Buildability Verdict
* **Verdict:** `ready_now`
* **Main Blocker:** `none`
* **Notes:** ClickUp provides comprehensive public documentation, an official OpenAPI spec, and an official hosted MCP server. Because OAuth credentials can be generated instantly on a free tier account without any administrative approval or partner barriers, a developer can build and ship a multi-tenant agent toolkit immediately.
